options.name: drives_layout
options.description: Partitioning schema for drives during reinstallation. Mutually exclusive with I(drives_layout_template). Translates to drives["layout"] in API. List of configuration for each raid or a stand-alone drive. At least one layout should be provided. Slot 0 must be used. Partitioning should provide at least '/' (root) and /boot (for Linux) or 'C:' for Windows. Only paritioning for dirve 'C:' is supported for Windows.

options.name: drives_layout_template
options.description: Mutually exclusive with I(drives_layout). Provides a template to use instead of I(drives_layout). C(raid1-simple) uses two first drives to create RAID1, partition /boot (1Gb), swap (4Gb) and / (all other space). C(raid0-simple) uses first two drives to create RAID0, partition /boot (1Gb), swap (4Gb) and / (all other space). C(no-raid) uses first drive, does not create any RAID, partition /boot (1Gb), swap (4Gb) and / (all other space). This option is implemented by this module (it generates layo

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Endpoint to use to connect to API. Do not change until specifically asked to do otherwise. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Hostname for the server. Module will retrieve old server title if not specified. Translates to hostname in API.

options.name: operating_system_id
options.description: id of the operating system to install on the server. Module will retrieve and reuse old operating system if not specified. Mutually exclusive with I(operating_system_regex).

options.name: operating_system_regex
options.description: Regular expression to filter operating systems by name. If specified, the module will install operating system that match the provided regex (case insensitive). Mutually exclusive with I(operating_system_id).

options.name: server_id
options.description: ID of the server to reinstall.

options.name: ssh_key_name
options.description: Name of a single ssh key to add to root user. Mutually exclusive with I(ssh_keys). Server is reinstalled with root password only if no I(ssh_keys) or I(ssh_key_name) specified. Name is used to search fingerprint through ssh keys API requests. Key should be registered. This option is implemented by the module.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: Array of fingerprints of public ssh keys to add for root user. Keys must be registered before use by module M(serverscom.sc_api.ssh_key). Mutually exclusive with I(ssh_key_name). Server is reinstalled with root password only if no I(ssh_keys) or I(ssh_key_name) specified.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use. You can create token for your account in https://portal.servers.com in Profile -> Public API section. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) or C(SC_TOKEN) environment variable is used (C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) takes precedence). Value is not logged.

options.name: update_interval
options.description: Interval in seconds for requests for server status. Each update request reduces number of available API requests in accordance with ratelimit. Minimal value is 10. Ignored if I(wait)=C(0).

options.name: user_data
options.description: User data content that will be processed by the cloud-init while server's initialization.

options.name: wait
options.description: Time to wait for server to change status to 'ready' If wait is 0 or absent, task is succeeded sending reuest to API without waiting. When server become 'ready' after reinstallation, it can still be in booting state for some time and do not answer ssh/ping request. Use M(serverscom.sc_api.wait_for_connection) module to wait the server to become available though ssh. Installation may start few minutes later than request, during this time server is responding with 'old' ssh.
